machine_profile.summary: Generic template for mining and mineral-processing equipment: rotary kilns, crushers, grinding mills, haul trucks and gensets.
machine_profile.typical_duty: Continuous heavy-duty operation in abrasive, dusty conditions; mobile equipment runs 18 to 22 hours a day.

operating_parameters.label: Kiln shell temperature
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Hot spots warn of refractory loss.

operating_parameters.label: Preheater pressure drop
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: A rise signals cyclone build-up and blockage.

operating_parameters.label: Kiln speed
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Speed changes affect the coating and product quality.

operating_parameters.label: Mill power draw
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Power per tonne is the main grinding energy indicator.

operating_parameters.label: Crusher closed-side setting
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Liner wear opens the setting and the product size grows.

operating_parameters.label: Engine exhaust temperature
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Rising exhaust temperature at the same load means injector or turbo trouble.

operating_parameters.label: Tailings slurry density
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Low density wastes water; high density risks line blockage.

operating_parameters.label: Ambient dust at the transfer points
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Dust is both a health and an air-pollution indicator.

snag_types.name: Fuel injector drift
symptoms: Misfire, knocking or rising fuel use
snag_types.detection_method: Cylinder exhaust temperatures and fuel per hour

severity_levels.definition: First sign of fuel injector drift: exhaust temperature spread between cylinders noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: exhaust temperature spread between cylinders confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: black smoke on load; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: misfire, knocking or rising fuel use; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate on misfire alarms or knocking

snag_types.immediate_action: Reduce the load and plan an injector test
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate on misfire alarms or knocking

pollution_effects.effect: Incomplete combustion raises CO2, NOx and soot.

snag_types.name: Sensor drift
symptoms: Readings that disagree with a portable instrument
Control loop hunting or wrong trips

severity_levels.definition: First sign of sensor drift: readings that disagree with a portable instrument noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: readings that disagree with a portable instrument confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: nuisance alarms; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: control loop hunting or wrong trips; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if a safety-critical sensor is affected

snag_types.immediate_action: Put the loop in manual if safe and book a calibration
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if a safety-critical sensor is affected

pollution_effects.effect: Mis-controlled combustion or dust systems raise emissions.

snag_types.name: Kiln shell hot spot
symptoms: Shell scanner shows a local rise
snag_types.detection_method: Continuous shell scanner and night inspection

severity_levels.definition: First sign of kiln shell hot spot: shell scanner shows a local rise noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: shell scanner shows a local rise confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: glowing shell at night; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: shell above 400 c; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the shell exceeds 450 C or deforms

snag_types.immediate_action: Use the shell cooling fans and adjust the flame; plan a reline
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the shell exceeds 450 C or deforms

pollution_effects.effect: Heat loss raises fuel per tonne and CO2.

snag_types.name: Preheater fouling
snag_types.detection_method: Preheater dP and cyclone temperatures; blockage alarms

severity_levels.definition: First sign of preheater fouling: rising preheater dp noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: rising preheater dp confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: cyclone outlet temperature changes; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: cyclone blockage or meal flushes; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if a cyclone blocks

snag_types.immediate_action: Run the air blasters and check the meal chemistry

pollution_effects.effect: More fan power and fuel raise CO2.

snag_types.name: Girth gear wear
symptoms: Vibration or pitting and tooth damage
snag_types.detection_method: Contact pattern check, vibration and gear temperature

severity_levels.definition: First sign of girth gear wear: gear noise noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: gear noise confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: poor contact pattern; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: vibration or pitting and tooth damage; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate on any broken tooth

snag_types.immediate_action: Check the lubrication spray and plan alignment

pollution_effects.effect: Spent gear lubricant is a contaminated waste.
Unplanned kiln stops and restarts burn extra fuel.

snag_types.name: Kiln seal leak
symptoms: False air at the kiln inlet or outlet
Inlet O2 rises with lower temperatures
snag_types.detection_method: Inlet O2 and a visual check of the seals

severity_levels.definition: First sign of kiln seal leak: false air at the kiln inlet or outlet noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: false air at the kiln inlet or outlet confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: meal spillage; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: inlet o2 rises with lower temperatures; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if spillage reaches unpaved ground

snag_types.immediate_action: Clean the spillage and plan seal replacement
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if spillage reaches unpaved ground

pollution_effects.effect: False air raises fuel use and CO2.

snag_types.name: Crusher or mill liner wear
symptoms: Liner bolts loose or liners cracked
snag_types.detection_method: Liner thickness measurement and product sizing

severity_levels.definition: First sign of crusher or mill liner wear: product size growing noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: product size growing confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: lower throughput; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: liner bolts loose or liners cracked; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the liner bolts break

snag_types.immediate_action: Adjust the setting and plan a liner change
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the liner bolts break

snag_types.name: Conveyor belt mistracking
symptoms: Edge damage or belt rubbing the structure

severity_levels.definition: First sign of conveyor belt mistracking: belt running off centre noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: belt running off centre confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: spillage along the conveyor; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: edge damage or belt rubbing the structure; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate on belt damage or fire risk from friction

snag_types.immediate_action: Clean the spillage and plan tracking adjustment
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate on belt damage or fire risk from friction

snag_types.name: Dust suppression failure
symptoms: Visible dust at the transfer points
snag_types.detection_method: Visual check and dust monitor readings

severity_levels.definition: First sign of dust suppression failure: visible dust at the transfer points noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: visible dust at the transfer points confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: dry spray nozzles; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: dust plume leaving the site; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the dust monitor exceeds the permit limit

snag_types.immediate_action: Switch to manual water spray and inform EHS
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the dust monitor exceeds the permit limit

snag_types.name: Tailings line leak

severity_levels.definition: First sign of tailings line leak: pressure drop along the line noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: pressure drop along the line confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: wet ground along the route; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: slurry spraying or flowing; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if slurry reaches a watercourse

snag_types.immediate_action: Stop the pump, contain the slurry, and inform EHS
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if slurry reaches a watercourse

snag_types.name: Hydraulic hose burst
symptoms: Sudden loss of function and oil on the ground

severity_levels.definition: First sign of hydraulic hose burst: oil weeping at a fitting noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: oil weeping at a fitting confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: oil spray; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: sudden loss of function and oil on the ground; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if oil reaches a drain or watercourse

snag_types.immediate_action: Stop, lower the attachments, and deploy the spill kit
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if oil reaches a drain or watercourse

snag_types.name: Haul truck tyre damage
snag_types.detection_method: Daily pre-start check and pressure monitoring

severity_levels.definition: First sign of haul truck tyre damage: cuts or low pressure noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: cuts or low pressure confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: uneven wear; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: bulge or heat separation; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate on any bulge or heat damage

snag_types.immediate_action: Park the truck safely and inspect
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate on any bulge or heat damage

pollution_effects.effect: Rolling resistance raises diesel use and CO2.
Scrap tyres are a solid waste stream.

snag_types.name: Mill trunnion bearing overheating
snag_types.detection_method: Bearing temperature and lube oil analysis

severity_levels.definition: First sign of mill trunnion bearing overheating: rising bearing temperature noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: rising bearing temperature confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: lube oil darkening; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: bearing temperature alarm; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate on an alarm or a trip

snag_types.immediate_action: Check the lube system and reduce the load
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate on an alarm or a trip

pollution_effects.effect: Used lube oil is hazardous waste.
Unplanned mill stops waste energy at restart.
